description: Deploy and drive this firm's approved state machines: create one from its reviewed definition, start it, read it and its runs, retry a failed run, or delete it.

op.description: create: deploy the approved definition. start: run it. get: it and its recent runs. list: what is deployed. delete: stop what is running, then remove. retry: resume a failed run.

name.description: The definition's key under the approved machines prefix, e.g. 'collections/dunning.asl.json'. Required for every op but list and retry.

input.description: start: the execution's input. Carry cabinet KEYS and ids, never values — execution state is capped and a step reads what it needs fresh.

execution.description: retry: the execution arn to resume, from get.

reason.description: delete: why, recorded on each execution this stops so the owner can see what was cut short.
